endpoint_reframing: The successor uses a cumulative evidence score. False-positive correction is an operational diagnostic at a frozen cutoff, not the definition of the score.

score_rule.formula: S_lambda(s) = sum_i I_i(s) + lambda * sum_i I_i(s) F_i(s)
score_rule.lambda_interpretation: one equal evidence point for a correct local fact and one for its gated recovery of the shared G
score_rule.cutoff_interpretation: at least two total evidence points: two local hits, or one local hit plus its correct gated G recovery
score_rule.parameter_selection: development calibration plus an interpretable equal-weight rule; no formal victim response was used

preserve.initial_gate: initial response is evaluated per slot
preserve.shared_G: one frozen remote target per source reused by all follow-up arms
preserve.runtime_rule: conditional sending only; no conditional query construction

core_required_arms.definition: canonical e_i answer inserted into same-slot follow-up
same G question without local anchor
core_required_arms.purpose: control for generic follow-up rejection without local anchor

optional_attribution_arms.definition: another local fact from same source; fixed cyclic mapping e1<-e2, e2<-e3, e3<-e1
optional_attribution_arms.purpose: secondary attribution control; distinguish correct pairing from arbitrary source-local cue, extra length, or template specificity

optional_matched_controls.definition: same dataset and fact type, length-matched anchor from another source
optional_matched_controls.purpose: source specificity diagnostic on matched subset

optional_matched_controls.definition: natural length-matched template without semantic source cue
optional_matched_controls.purpose: query length diagnostic only if frozen before victim calls

budget.note: correct_anchor and remote_only are core; same_source_permuted_anchor is optional attribution control; all variants require a new successor identity

primary_metrics.source_score: S_lambda as the primary source-level score
primary_metrics.score_auc: AUC of S_lambda without post-hoc threshold selection
primary_metrics.operational_false_positive_set: True_Non_Member sources with sum(I_i) >= frozen initial_gate_points
primary_metrics.correction_indicator: 1[initial gate positive and S_lambda < frozen operational cutoff]
primary_metrics.false_positive_correction_rate: corrected initial false positives / initial false positives
primary_metrics.fpr_tpr: Report FPR and Member TPR at the same frozen operational cutoff
primary_metrics.member_retention: Member sources positive after the cutoff / Member sources positive at the initial gate
primary_metrics.reporting_rule: Report exact counts, score distributions, AUC, and uncertainty; do not call 2/2 a stable population rate.

freeze_before_victim: e1/e2/e3, G, evidence spans and region relation
lambda, initial gate points and operational score cutoff
canonical answer aliases and ambiguous policy
source-cluster statistics and Holm correction plan
decision_rules: the primary result is the frozen source-level point score and its AUC
use the cutoff only for the pre-registered false-positive correction diagnostic
report Member retention and TPR cost alongside every correction result
correct_anchor versus remote_only is an attribution comparison, not a requirement for a stable G-recovery gain
same_source_permuted_anchor is secondary attribution evidence and may be run on a matched subset
if the initial false-positive set is too small, report feasibility only and do not claim a stable correction rate
do not relabel current responses after seeing them; parser changes belong to successor freeze
multiple_comparison: pre-specify Holm correction only if optional attribution arms are included
